clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —   Requirements for flanged reflux valves of single door, swing check type used for water works purposes of sizes 50 to 600 mm.

clauses.title: Nominal Pressure
clauses.text: 2. Nominal Pressure Sizes of Valves       Nominal Pressure (PN) mm MPa 50 to 125 1.6 150 to 300 1.0 350 to 600 0.6

clauses.title: Nominal Sizes
clauses.text: 3. Nominal Sizes 50, 65, 80, 100, 125, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500 and 600 mm. The nominal size shall refer to the nominal bore of the water way. The actual bore at any point shall not be less than the nominal size.

clauses.title: All the parts of
clauses.text: 5.1 All the parts of the valves shall be desinged so as to withstand the specified test pressures.

clauses.title: The area for flow passage at any cross
clauses.text: 5.2 The area for flow passage at any cross-section in the valve shall not be less than the area of the nominal bore of the valve.

clauses.title: The design of hinge,
clauses.text: 5.3 The design of hinge, hinge pin, door and door suspension shall be such to ensure free swinging of the door.

clauses.title: The design of valves
clauses.text: 5.4 The design of valves used in verticl pipe lines shall be such that in the working position the valves positively close when the flow in the pipe comes to a stop.

clauses.title: The thickness of metal
clauses.text: 5.5 The thickness of metal in all castings shall be maintained as uniform as possible throughout any section to avoid strains set up by sudden changes of cross - section.

clauses.title: Each
clauses.text: 5.6 Each  reflux valve shall carry in arrow, very prominently to indicate the direction of flow.

clauses.title: Unless otherwise specified in
clauses.text: 5.7 Unless otherwise specified in the contract or order, the flanges and their dimensions of drilling shall be in accordance with IS 1535.

clauses.title: The inside diameter of
clauses.text: 5.8 The inside diameter of the body sing shall not be less than the nominal bore of the valve.

clauses.title: Doors and Hings
clauses.text: 5.9 Doors and Hings - The design of the doors and hings shall be suitable so as the withstand satisfactaly the repuated impact likely to occur during service

clauses.title: Door faces
clauses.text: 5.10 Door faces - The minimum thickness of door shall be 5 mm. Note — For detailed dimensions and tolerances  refer to the standard.

clauses.title: Coating – Shall be
clauses.text: 6. Coating - Shall be smooth, glossy and tenacious, sufficiently hard so as not to flow when exposed to a temperature of 77oC and not so brittle at a temperature of 15oC as to chip off when scratched lightly with a point of a per knife. Note— For alternative material see Table of the standard. For  detailed information, refer to IS  5312 (Part1) : 2004. Specification for swing check type reflux (nonreturn) valves for  water  works purposes Part 1- Single door pattern (second revision).

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Body Test
clauses.text: 7.1 Hydrostatic Body Test — Shall not show any leakage or  permanent distortion under the specified pressure .

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Seat Test
clauses.text: 7.2 Hydrostatic Seat Test — shall show no leakage when subjected to  the prescribed pressure.
